TEXT:
And with that, Kirino went quiet... An awkward 
silence grew between us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Can I ask you something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Back then... you said the following.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: --I've got my reasons, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Reasons that are my own business. I can't and don't 
plan on telling you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I'm afraid I can't help you guys out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...What did you mean by that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I don't plan on telling you, didn't I say that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I know that and that's why I'm asking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I need to know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No matter what.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I can't say it now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Kirino!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I know what you want to say.
And she was right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
It's about Saori, the black one, and even Ayase too, 
right?

Kirino pinpointed exactly what I wanted to talk 
about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Those girls are all opposed to Kanako and I dating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I know. We talked about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I also know that things don't look good the way 
they are now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If that's the case...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: IIIdiot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Calm down already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I'll settle this dispute properly.

It was as if she got over something or she might've 
prepared herself...

She had an encouraging smile befitting of my little 
sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is there anything that I can do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hmm, nah, it's not like there's nothing but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Don't you think you should return to your room for 
now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
The games I lent you and the game I gave to you 
as a present, aren't they all in your room right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ayase, let's play this game together.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I-Is that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, it's the game Kirino was playing yesterday.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-I-Isn't that one of those H-Games?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Yeah! I'll make every nook and cranny sparkle!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
OH CRAP!!!!!!!!!!! 
OHCRAPOHCRAPOHCRAPOHCRAP!!!
I sprinted up the stairs with a mad dash.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Pfft, you idiot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...See you tomorrow, Aniki.
